en.tip1: 1.Click and select the preset button above to view the corresponding subtitles;
en.tip2: 2.Click the input box to edit and save the modified text;
en.tip3: 3.Move the selection box in the preview area to change the position of the caption.

zh.tip1: 1.单击选中上方预设按钮可查看对应设置的字幕;
zh.tip2: 2.单击输入框可编辑修改文字并保存;
zh.tip3: 3.移动预览区内的选框可改变字幕的位置。
